name: nyc-2024
notes: System design 6B's first jobs: the four NYC taxi jobs on 2024 (41,169,720 rows), every engine of 6A and the native-expression rows (DuckDB SQL for Enrich and Occupancy, Polars expressions for Enrich), the median of 5 runs, the learning run and the noise pairs kept (the PM, 2026-11-18). The files are bench/vm/normalize.py's (one schema, 1M-row row groups). Every engine reads and writes the run's Blob container with its own reader. Memory is what each platform leaves on the same machine: 14 GiB for the Linux engines (16 GiB less 2 for the OS, as gate_plan.py's d4 machine keeps 2), the node's memory less 768 MiB for Moruna.
